title.narrative: CSO Programme - Multiannual Action Plan 2025-2027 - Action Document 3 - DEAR

description.narrative: Global citizenship education and Awareness Raising bring the EU¿s external action and policies closer to citizens and builds public support to (i) address global challenges, such as, digital transition, impact for climate change, shrinking democratic space, (ii) pursue policy coherence for sustainable development and (iii) promote EU values and interests. It directly engages citizens and mobilises public support in the EU and partner countries on global issues related to our international social, economic, and environmental agenda, highlighting their interconnectedness with the rest of the world and the importance of sustainable development, both locally and globally.This action intends to: (i)empower people to increase their engagement on and understanding of international partnership issues and the SDGs, (ii)promote formal, informal and non-formal global citizenship education, especially among youth, (iii)promote knowledge sharing between the relevant actors, (iv)mobilise public support in the European Union, candidate countries and potential candidates for international partnerships with partner countries.The present action proposes to:(i)work with CSOs, notably youth and grass-roots organisations, covering the above-mentioned objectives, in Europe and in partner countries. (ii)support CSOs platforms of countries holding the EU Presidency to promote awareness/advocate for international partnerships issues to wider public and decision makers.  Implementation of this MAAP will cover the EU Presidencies of Ireland, Lithuania and Greece (06/2026-12/2027), Italia, Latvia and Luxembourg (01/2028-06/2029).(iii)building bridges between European & partner countries¿ youth(iv)Increase and improve global education mainstreaming, notably in European countries, building on the European Declaration on Global Education to 2050, facilitating the exchange on Global Citizenship Education policies and practice between EU Member State authorities across the education and development ministries in a Team Europe approach (GENE- Global Education Network Europe).The action is aligned with the geopolitical objectives of the Commission, building the support of EU citizens, particularly youth, for international partnership with partner countries.
